items.name: Chipped Teacup
items.description: Still warm, though nobody has poured it in years. Stirring it clockwise is said to bring a pleasant afternoon.

items.name: Brass Candlestick
items.description: Its flame has never once flickered, and the wax never shortens. The tower library keeps misplacing it on purpose.

items.name: Old Brass Key
items.description: It fits no lock in the tower, yet every door seems faintly relieved when it passes by.

items.name: Sand Hourglass
items.description: The sand falls upward on Tuesdays. Nobody has ever caught the exact moment it changes its mind.

items.name: Star Lantern
items.description: A captured star hums inside the glass, dimming whenever someone nearby tells a lie. It is very rarely dim.
